capabilities: Uploads pasted images to the configured image host
Uploads all local images in a note from the command palette
Replaces local image links with hosted URLs
Downloads internet images to the vault
Uploads single images from the right-click menu
extras: Needs at least one uploader (PicGo app with its server enabled, PicList, or npm-installed picgo-core) plus an image host whose account, cost, and visibility are outside the plugin; per-note opt-out via frontmatter image-auto-upload: false; credentials stay in local plugin config; download-all-images only tested on Windows 10; manual install copies main.js and manifest.json into .obsidian/plugins/yuhanbo-image-upload/.
problem: Obsidian keeps pasted and embedded images as local attachments, so using an external image host means uploading manually and editing links by hand.
